arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
src=$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-leads-membership-release.XXXXXX)
bundle=/opt/telegram-robot-leads/.telegram-leads-release-28640b23189ec554bbf578a17351a8b73a191de2.tgz
trap 'sudo -n rm -f -- "$bundle"; rm -rf -- "$src"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/telegram-robot-leads.git "$src"
test "$(git -C "$src" rev-parse HEAD)" = "28640b23189ec554bbf578a17351a8b73a191de2"
sudo -n -H /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python -B -m unittest discover -s "$src/tests" -q
python3 -B - "$src" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util,sys,tarfile
root=Path(sys.argv[1])
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("installer",root/"scripts/deploy_project_only.py")
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
assert "scripts/member_groups.py" in mod.RUNTIME_FILES
assert len(mod.RUNTIME_FILES)==len(set(mod.RUNTIME_FILES))
with tarfile.open(root/"runtime.tgz","w:gz") as tar:
 for name in mod.RUNTIME_FILES:
  source=root/name
  assert source.is_file() and not source.is_symlink()
  tar.add(source,arcname=name,recursive=False)
print("RELEASE_MANIFEST",len(mod.RUNTIME_FILES),flush=True)
PY
sudo -n install -o root -g root -m 600 "$src/runtime.tgz" "$bundle"
sudo -n -H /usr/bin/python3 -B "$src/scripts/deploy_project_only.py" --bundle "$bundle" --commit "28640b23189ec554bbf578a17351a8b73a191de2" --expected-installed "45b085c788814c481d6c7922cf7789c144109f9c"
sudo -n env PM2_HOME=/root/.pm2 pm2 jlist | python3 -c 'import sys,json; rows=json.load(sys.stdin); x=[j for j in rows if j.get("name")=="telegram-robot-leads"]; assert len(x)==1 and x[0]["pm2_env"]["status"]=="online"; print("PREDEPLOY_PM2_PASS")'
sudo -n -H /usr/bin/python3 -B "$src/scripts/deploy_project_only.py" --bundle "$bundle" --commit "28640b23189ec554bbf578a17351a8b73a191de2" --expected-installed "45b085c788814c481d6c7922cf7789c144109f9c" --apply --confirm-telegram-only
sudo -n -H /usr/bin/python3 -B /opt/telegram-robot-leads/scripts/project_hygiene.py --apply --confirm-telegram-only
sudo -n env PM2_HOME=/root/.pm2 pm2 restart telegram-robot-leads
sudo -n env PM2_HOME=/root/.pm2 pm2 jlist | python3 -c 'import json,sys; rows=json.load(sys.stdin); t=[x for x in rows if x.get("name")=="telegram-robot-leads"]; assert len(t)==1; e=t[0]["pm2_env"]; assert e["status"]=="online" and e["pm_exec_path"]=="/opt/telegram-robot-leads/main.py" and e.get("TELEGRAM_REGIONAL_PUBLIC_DISCOVERY_ENABLED")=="1"; print("TARGET_PM2",e["status"],"REGIONAL",e.get("TELEGRAM_REGIONAL_PUBLIC_DISCOVERY_ENABLED")); other=[x for x in rows if x.get("name")=="iptvpn_bot"]; assert len(other)==1 and other[0]["pm2_env"]["status"]=="online"; print("OTHER_BOT_UNTOUCHED",other[0]["pm2_env"]["restart_time"])'
test "$(sudo -n cat /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.verified-source-commit)" = "28640b23189ec554bbf578a17351a8b73a191de2"
sudo -n -H /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python -B /opt/telegram-robot-leads/scripts/leads_operational_report.py --expected-source "28640b23189ec554bbf578a17351a8b73a191de2" --with-pm2 | python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin); assert r["source"]["matches_expected"] is True and r["pm2"]["status"]=="ONLINE" and r["sessions"]["accounts"]==2; print("STATUS",r["status"],"REGISTRY",r.get("group_memberships",{}).get("status"),"GROUPS",r.get("public_discovery",{}).get("public_groups"))'
echo MEMBER_REGISTRY_DEPLOYED
